svg.title: Two tanks and their state-space model
svg.desc: When the pump rises by 0.001 cubic metres per second, tank 1 moves first and tank 2 follows; tank 2 keeps rising until 37 seconds, 17 seconds after the pump returns. The model follows both levels, within 0.57 millimetres when lowering.
svg.text: Two tanks and their state-space model
Control Studio recording of this project · pump steps ±0.001 m³/s for 20 s · numbers answer the predictions
Tank 1 moves first: +1.96 mm in 1 s,
Lowering: model 0.57 mm off at 20 s
